name: Fraction Basics
description: Understanding numerator (parts you have) and denominator (total equal parts).

name: Equal Part Partitioning
description: Recognizing that fractions require strictly equal parts of a whole.

name: Fraction as Division
description: Understanding that a/b represents dividing 'a' items equally among 'b' recipients (e.g., 3 pizzas among 4 people = 3/4 each).

name: Equivalent Fractions
description: Recognizing different fractions that represent the same value by scaling numerator and denominator.

name: Comparing Fractions
description: Comparing fractions with common or different denominators.

name: Adding Fractions
description: Adding fractions with matching denominators and understanding common denominators.
